nodes.name: Recorder - conversation analyzed
nodes.notes: Point your recorder's 'conversation analyzed' webhook here. The payload should carry the call id and account.

nodes.name: Recorder - fetch call
nodes.notes: Fetch the analyzed call (transcript + attendees). No Gong? Swap for your recorder's API, or ingest the export via the gtmsi adapters.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: =SELECT Id, Name, AnnualRevenue, (SELECT Product2.Name FROM OpportunityLineItems) FROM Account WHERE Name = '{{ $json.accountName }}'

nodes.name: Salesforce - account products + ACV + renewal
nodes.notes: Read what the account already owns (current products, ACV, renewal date) so the prompt only pitches what they lack.

nodes.name: Slack - post alert
nodes.notes: Add an IF before this node to post only for HIGH/MEDIUM opportunities (the prompt sends nothing below threshold).
